# Offline Pixel Task List

A fully offline, pixel-styled task list built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No network requests, no storage, no external assets.

## Features

- Add tasks via the input (`#todo-input`) and Add button (`#todo-add`).
- Blank or whitespace-only input is ignored; text is trimmed.
- Total task count shown in `#todo-total` and incomplete count in `#remaining`, both starting at 0.
- Each task gets a text span (`#todo-text-N`), checkbox (`#todo-check-N`), and delete button (`#todo-delete-N`), with increasing numeric IDs.
- Toggling a checkbox updates the incomplete count and strikes through the task text.
- Deleting a task removes it and updates both counts.
- All state is kept in memory only.

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Type a task and press Enter or click Add. Use the checkbox to mark done; use Delete to remove.

## Accessibility

- Labels and ARIA attributes on controls.
- Keyboard: Tab to navigate, Enter to add, Space to toggle checkboxes, Enter/Space to activate buttons.
- Visible focus, hover, and pressed states.

## Files

- `index.html` – structure
- `style.css` – pixel theme and responsive layout
- `script.js` – logic

## Constraints

Under 240 source lines total. No imports, packages, or server code. Layout works from 360px wide.
